slides.headline: pov: someone on your team is late again and you have to say something
start with what you saw
slides.sub: “you’ve been late a few times this week.” no guessing at why

slides.headline: then ask, and wait
slides.sub: “what’s going on?” then stop talking. let the quiet do its work

slides.headline: say what you need
slides.sub: “i need you here by nine. can you do that?”

slides.headline: agree what happens next
slides.sub: “let’s talk again on friday.” then really do it

slides.headline: save this for the day you need it

caption:
four lines for the talk most new managers put off for weeks.

save it. you will need it sooner than you think.
